title.zh: Coinbase Files SEC Notices to Bring Single-Stock Perpetuals to U.S. - Coin Edition
title.en: Coinbase Files SEC Notices to Bring Single-Stock Perpetuals to U.S. - Coin Edition

current_state.zh: Coinbase 已根据证券期货规则提交国内股票永续合约申请，但面临 CME 诉讼，使推出前景不确定。
